theorem readyNstate.proj_outbox (s : NState) (L : Option SnapLoan) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) :
    (readyNstate s L ce sz).outbox = []

theorem readyNstate.proj_votes (s : NState) (L : Option SnapLoan) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) :
    (readyNstate s L ce sz).votes = s.votes

def readySteps (s : NState) (L : Option SnapLoan) (selfs : List Pending) (ce : List EntryM) : List
    Pending :=
  (selfs ++
      if s.logst.uents = [] ∧ L = none then []
      else
        [Pending.appendAck s.term s.logst.prev
            (if s.logst.uents ≠ [] then some (plogLast s.logst.prev (s.logst.sents ++ s.logst.uents)) else none)
            (Option.map SnapLoan.snap L)]) ++
    if ce = [] then [] else [Pending.applyAck ce]

    (readyNstate s L ce sz).rd = have __src := s.rd; { ro := __src.ro, pend := __src.pend }

theorem ready_stepsOk (s' : NState) (t : w64) (b : entryID) (last : Option entryID) (sn : Option
    SnapshotM) (ce : List EntryM) (u : Prop) [Decidable u] (Ht : uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z s'.term) (Hl : ¬u
    → ∀ (x : entryID), last = some x → plogLast b s'.logst.stored = x ∧ 1 ≤ uint.Z t) (Hce : ∀ (e :
    EntryM), ce.getLast? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' ≤ uint.Z s'.logst.committed ∧ uint.Z e.Index' ≤
    uint.Z s'.logst.applying) : StepsOk s' ((if u then [] else [Pending.appendAck t b last sn]) ++
    if ce = [] then [] else [Pending.applyAck ce])

theorem stepsOk_selfs (s : NState) (selfs rest : List Pending) (Hs : ∀ (p : Pending), p ∈ selfs → (∃
    pv t, p = Pending.self pv t) ∧ PendingOk s p) (Hr : StepsOk s rest) : StepsOk s (selfs ++ rest)

theorem toPState_ready (s : NState) (L : Option SnapLoan) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) : toPState
    (readyNstate s L ce sz) = have __src := toPState s; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote,
    lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := [], base := __src.base,
    log := __src.log, commit := __src.commit, matched := __src.matched, rd :=
        have __src := (toPState s).rd;
        { ro := __src.ro, pend := __src.pend } }

def loanTrip (L : Option SnapLoan) : Option SnapTrip :=
  Option.map (fun l => snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) L

def readyNstate (s : NState) (L : Option SnapLoan) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) : NState :=
  { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := [], stepfn := s.stepfn,
    ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log,
    logst := logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable (rdyLs L s.logst)) ce sz, prvals := s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote,
    gh :=
      have __src := s.gh;
      { tc := __src.tc, ns := __src.ns, xf := __src.xf, bt := __src.bt, slent := L.isSome, snp := loanTrip L },
    rd :=
      have __src := s.rd;
      { ro := __src.ro, pend := __src.pend },
    lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }

theorem readyNstate.proj_prvals (s : NState) (L : Option SnapLoan) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) :
    (readyNstate s L ce sz).prvals = s.prvals

def rdyLs (L : Option SnapLoan) (ls : LogState) : LogState :=
  if L.isSome = true then
    { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := ls.committed, applied := ls.applied,
      snap := ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted,
      stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl,
      sip := ls.sip, lent := true, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sxt := ls.sxt }
  else ls

theorem readyNstate.proj_lead (s : NState) (L : Option SnapLoan) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) :
    (readyNstate s L ce sz).lead = s.lead

theorem rdyLog_true (L : Option SnapLoan) (ls : LogState) : rdyLog true L.isSome ls = logHanded
    (rdyLs L ls)

theorem accept_fields (ls : LogState) (ce : List EntryM) (sz : w64) : (logAcceptApplying
    (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).prev = ls.prev ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce
    sz).snap = ls.snap ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).storage = ls.storage ∧
    (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).committed = ls.committed ∧ (logAcceptApplying
    (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).lent = ls.lent ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce
    sz).ksn = ls.ksn ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).sat = false ∧
    (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).sip = (ls.sip || ls.snap.isSome) ∧
    (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).fl = ls.fl ∧ (logAcceptApplying
    (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).applied = ls.applied ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls)
    ce sz).stored = ls.sents ++ ls.uents ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce
    sz).unpersisted = nextUnstable ls ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).uents =
    ls.uents ∧ (logAcceptApplying (logAcceptUnstable ls) ce sz).sents = ls.sents
